column1: What share of Japanese game developers used generative AI in the 2026 CESA survey?
column2: 85.8%, up from 51% the year before; 63% daily.

column1: What did respondents say they mostly use AI for?
column2: Debugging, fixing errors and automated testing, rather than putting AI output directly into code.
Humans confirm, modify and supervise every use; approved tools only; people own creative decisions and final quality.
Efficiency and productivity, shorter development cycles, lower costs.

column1: Which caution did CESA's director raise?
column2: New technology must not compromise intellectual property rights.
